notes.title: Nominate WORLD OF HORROR for the Steam Awards 2023!
notes.content:
From Early Access to v1.0, you've fought tooth and nail, baseball bat and broken bottle. You've offered your blood to weird nurses and peeked inside that package you found on the subway.

Maybe it didn't always make sense. Maybe it didn't always seem fair. But hey, it's called [i]WORLD OF HORROR[/i], we tried to warn you. We hope you love the game all the same.

It'd mean the WORLD to have your support in the Steam Awards. All you need to do is tick the box above!

Thank you as ever for your support!

notes.title: WORLD OF HORROR v1.0 - LIVE!
notes.content:
WORLD OF HORROR fans have been through a lot, we know! Through thick and thin, you've been waiting patiently for a long time for the game’s v1.0 release. We're stoked to announce the game has finally left Steam Early Access today, and we are also able to offer everyone the original Early Access price one more time as part of today's Steam Daily Deal!

To celebrate, witness this incredible (and incredibly vicious) animated trailer, handcrafted for us by the amazingly talented [url=https://twitter.com/karlsia_art]Karl Sia[/url] and scored by the game's composer [url=https://qwesta.bandcamp.com/]Joseph "Qwesta" Bailey[/url]:

[previewyoutube=SS8jIwzGp8U;full][/previewyoutube]

A side note for players looking to visit Shiokawa on Switch and PlayStation: [b]The game's digital console releases in North America and Europe have been delayed to Thursday, October 26th. [/b]

The Ysbryd Games team and panstasz have been laboring until the last possible moment to try and clear the necessary certification requirements and paperwork in time for our originally announced release date of October 19th. However, certain DOOM got the better of us, and we'll need one more run to finally clear these obstacles in North America and European regions - but we’ll get everyone to Shiokawa in time for Halloween!

Now, please savor your time in WORLD OF HORROR as it was truly intended to be!

notes.title: World Of Horror review: a weird and wonderful horror adventure in time for Halloween
notes.content:
Being as much of an insufferable, online-but-ultimately-in-quite-a-basic-way person as I am, I'm a Junji Ito girlie. The horror manga artist has an immediately recognisable style that intersects detailed, line heavy art with strange and upsetting concepts, and some of his short stories have acquired a sort of semi-memetic status ("This is my hole! It was made for me!"). If you're at all familiar with Junji Ito's work you will look at unforgiving almost-text-adventure World Of Horror and go "Huh, that's inspired by Junji Ito."

This isn't just because it looks like his work but rendered in MSPaint, or because it contains, just, direct references to it, but because of the whole vibe. You encounter face-sloughing-off kinds of monsters and vengeful spirits inspired by Japanese folkloric yokai, but also weirdo janitors doing stuff like turning the swim team into mermaids in a kind of pervier version of Tusk. At the same time, there's a streak of the Lovecraftian in play to keep it nice and legally distinct, as each self-contained run at the titular world is an attempt to save your town from destruction at the hands of an Old God (they earn the leaden thud of the capital letters). You will fail a lot. But isn't failure part of the fun!? Imagine that enthusiastic question as a big spoonful of marmite popped into your mouth.

Read more

notes.title: WORLD OF HORROR v1.0 Launch on October 19th, 2023
notes.content:
Here's a few pieces of news to chew on today!

[h2][u][b]V1.0 HALLOWEEN RELEASE[/b][/u][/h2]

[previewyoutube=6R1kw_VGigY;full][/previewyoutube]
In case you missed it, during the summer showcases it's been announced that WORLD OF HORROR will leave Steam Early Access on [b][u]October 19th, 2023[/u][/b]! The full game will include a frightening array of changes, the highlights being 3 new mysteries and 2 playable characters not yet seen in the Early Access builds.

We'd like to emphasize the localizations as well: The Asian regional release of WORLD OF HORROR v1.0 is published by our friends at PLAYISM, and thus the game will be available to play in Japanese, Simplified and Traditional Chinese, Korean. We are also adding French and German localizations for our players in Europe.

[h2][u][b]PHYSICAL EDITIONS[/b][/u][/h2]

Here's another cool thing for those who like collecting physical editions: WORLD OF HORROR will find its way to retail stores near you in physical form! We expect these to become available during the launch period as well.

In North America and Europe, the Nintendo Switch physical edition of WORLD OF HORROR will be brought to you by [b]Fangamer[/b]! Each physical edition includes an instruction manual and a set of art cards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33542786/9ee6d734c4d6617f553849939298222eefbb781c.jpg[/img]
This Nintendo Switch physical edition is presently available for preorder at Fangamer's store, alongside other cool WOH merch: https://www.fangamer.com/products/world-of-horror-game-nintendo-switch


For our WORLD OF HORROR fans in Asia, Nintendo Switch and PS4 physical editions will be released through [b]PLAYISM[/b]! There's exclusive preorder bonuses for ordering the game from particular retailers, such as Amazon JP and Yodobashi Camera, so learn more about how to pick your poison at https://playism.com/game/world-of-horror/ (note: website in Japanese and Simplified Chinese only).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33542786/24237ea03be29a0574dc1eef5644fe50669592b7.jpg[/img]

[h2][b][u]PRICE INCREASE[/u][/b][/h2]

Lastly, in line with the arrival of the v1.0 version and content expansions since launch, [u][b]WORLD OF HORROR will undergo a price increase on Steam to US$19.99 or its regional equivalent.[/b][/u] This will take place very soon, so please take advantage of the current pricing if you don't already own the game, or were thinking to gift a little piece of SHIOKAWA's eldritch horror to your friends and loved ones.

Thanks for reading!

notes.title: World of Horror will actually finally release in October
notes.content: Honestly I should know better by now than to publish stories with titles like "World of Horror will finally release in Summer 2023" because that is a guarantee that the game in question will not finally release at whatever time or date I have said. This is a tempting opportunity that the universe will use to humble me, something I have failed to learn after ten years of writing about games... Read more.

notes.title: World of Horror gets more horror in its Halloween update
notes.content:
World of Horror, the Apple IIe-style horror game based on the artwork of manga artist Junji Ito, has a well-timed update out that adds some Halloween goodies. The update adds new outfits for the main characters, as well as new endings for all the currently available missions.

While World of Horror is still in development, it's available in Steam Early Access (where it's currently discounted 13%) and Xbox Game Pass Game Preview form at the moment, and there's already plenty of unsettling cosmic horror to find. Each investigation in the game has randomised roguelike encounters, so you'll never be able to chart a consistent path through. Now, with the Halloween update, there are new endings to discover for each mystery, and you can be sure they'll be suitably gruesome - even with the lo-fi '80s manga graphics.

You'll also notice new costumes for each of the game's playable characters - which is a funny thing to add to a game so dedicated to a visual style that predates downloadable horse armour by a few decades. Hey, this is cosmic horror - time has no real meaning in World of Horror.

Read the rest of the story...

RELATED LINKS:
Junji Ito, HP Lovecraft, and the Apple II combine in World of Horror

notes.title: World of Horror, a creepy 1-bit style horror RPG, will release next month
notes.content:
World of Horror is a gorgeous horror RPG with an art style inspired by manga artist Junji Ito. Presented in an austere 1-bit aesthetic (think The Return of Obra Dinn), it's a card-oriented RPG with roguelite elements, turn-based combat, puzzles, choice driven scenarios... basically, it seems to be a lot of things, and it's the game I'm most excited to play in early 2020.

"The Old Gods are reawakening, clawing their way back into a world that’s spiraling into a mysterious madness," so reads the Steam description. "In a small, seaside town of Japan, the population’s sanity is dwindling and otherworldly, grotesque creatures terrorize those who call the place home. In World of Horror, it’s the end of the world and the only solution is to confront the terror reigning over the apocalypse."

Developed by Pawel Kozminski aka panstasz, the game also features writing by Cassandra Khaw, best know for work on Wasteland 3 and Sunless Skies, as well as the novel Hammers on Bone. It'll launch into Early Access on February 20 with five playable characters and ten mysteries. When the game launches proper later in the year it'll get more characters, mysteries and events. If you're desperate to check it out sooner, there's currently a demo available on panstasz's Itch page.
